prompt:
Generate one high-fidelity UI design comp image of the HOME screen of a private desktop web app "VXP Command Center" for one owner running three Indian D2C stores (Oorvia, Kaiven, Selnova). Store switcher set to "All VXP", tab "Home", period 7D (11–17 Nov).
REGIONS top to bottom:
1. TOP BAR: left "VXP" wordmark; tabs "Home  Ads  Orders  Money" (current tab underlined); centre a segmented store switcher "All VXP | Oorvia | Kaiven | Selnova"; right date presets "Today  7D  30D  Month" and a small green LIVE dot with "synced 4 min ago".
2. HERO ROW: left two-thirds: small label "PROJECTED PROFIT · 7D · ALL STORES", huge number "₹9,640" (the only gradient number, mint), under it a single plain sentence in large readable type: "Kaiven is paying for itself. Selnova isn't — yet." and a small grey line "Realised so far ₹3,210 · profit uses an assumed 72% delivery rate". Right third: "NEEDS YOUR CALL" with exactly two compact cards stacked: (1) coral left bar, "Selnova below breakeven 3 days", grey line "ROAS 2.41× vs 2.55× · ₹9,860 spent", small chip "Fix or pause"; (2) green left bar, "Kaiven can scale", grey line "ROAS 3.11× vs 2.40× breakeven", chip "Scale".
3. MIDDLE ROW: left two-thirds: a clean cumulative line chart for 11–17 Nov with three lines — booked revenue (mint), ad spend (violet), projected profit (white, labelled "estimate") — and previous period as a faint dotted line; a small legend; end-of-line labels ₹87,142 / ₹28,280 / ₹9,640. Right third: "LIVE ORDERS" compact list of exactly 5 rows, each: store colour dot + store name, product, ₹ amount, a small COD or Prepaid tag, "2 min ago". Products: Kaiven "Deoxyribose Scalp Serum" ₹1,399; Selnova "PDRN Ampoule" ₹1,699; Oorvia "Microinfusion System" ₹1,999. Link "All orders →".
4. STORE SCOREBOARD: a clean table, no heavy borders, columns: Store · Spend · Orders · Booked revenue · ROAS / breakeven (a thin horizontal bar with a tick at breakeven and the verdict word) · Contribution. Rows: Kaiven ₹18,420 · 41 · ₹57,359 · 3.11× / 2.40× Scale · ₹8,930; Selnova ₹9,860 · 14 · ₹23,786 · 2.41× / 2.55× Below · −₹1,180; Oorvia ₹0 · 3 · ₹5,997 · no ads · ₹1,890; then a bold "VXP total" row ₹28,280 · 58 · ₹87,142 · — · ₹9,640.
5. FOOTER LINE (one quiet line of grey text, no panel): "Cash ₹1,42,300 · covers 18 days of spend   ·   GST November ₹11,280 due 20 Dec   ·   Your share (50%) MTD ₹4,820   →  Money".
VISUAL WORLD: dark graphite background (#0b0d10), but CALM and SPACIOUS — this is the opposite of a crowded neon dashboard. Generous whitespace between regions (at least 32px), few panels, hairline 1px borders only where needed, no glow, no glassmorphism, no gradient fills on boxes. Colour only carries meaning: green = good / scale, coral = bad / below breakeven, amber = COD or warning, and a small store colour dot (Kaiven teal, Selnova violet, Oorvia sand). At most ONE gradient number on the screen (the hero). Typography does the work: one large hero number, clear mid-size section titles, small uppercase letter-spaced labels naming metric, period and source. Body text readable (16px at 1440 wide). Fewer than 15 numbers visible in total. Aligned 12-column grid. Premium, quiet, like a high-end fintech app. Render the web page itself edge to edge, 16:9 landscape desktop 1440px wide; no browser window, no device frame.
